UML:TaggedValue.value: Standalone bounded-context model for Deposit Account Operations after account creation. Package 01 was decomposed to reduce coupling: 01A owns account core/servicing, 01B lifecycle, 01C hold controls, while cross-cutting approval/idempotency/bulk orchestration moved to 00 Governance & Control. Party-access records are in 06, servicing contact in 05 and the closure header in 16. Product Builder, Deposit Account Opening, Party, Enterprise GL and external channels remain integration contracts; identifiers are retained without cross-boundary physical FKs. Integration contract with Deposit Account Opening clarified: Opening orchestrates the request; Account Operations owns account identity allocation (ACCOUNT_ID/ACCOUNT_NO), account master and post-opening operational state. Cross-subdomain references are integration keys/lineage fields without physical FKs. Teller/Cash Management is an external bounded context for physical cash, teller sessions, cash drawers/vaults and denomination handling; Deposit Account Operations stores only account-side transaction and correlation data. Package 17 owns deposit subledger entries, current balance projection, debit reservations and daily balance snapshots. Service-originated account controls retain origin ownership and caller lineage; Collateral holds are service-to-service controls and cannot be created or released by teller users. Account activation is a gated orchestration: creation in PENDING_ACTIVATION does not permit normal customer use. Mandatory creation/readiness checks, external account-registry confirmation, financial settlement and required operational setup must complete before ACTIVATE. Restricted-active scenarios are represented with transaction/regulatory restrictions instead of overloading lifecycle status.

Canonical deposit account monetary subledger, current balance projection, authorization/debit reservations and daily balance snapshots. DEPOSIT_SUBLEDGER_ENTRY is append-only and represents booked account effects. DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT_BALANCE is a current projection optimized for operational availability checks and must be updated atomically with successful posting. Teller/Cash Management remains external for physical cash; Enterprise GL remains external for general-ledger ownership.

Operational commands/events for activate, suspend, reactivate, dormancy transition, close and controlled reopen. ACTIVATE is never a direct status flip: EVENT_TYPE_CODE=ACTIVATE requires ACTIVATION_RUN_ID and the executing service must verify a successful DEPOSIT_ACTIVATION_RUN whose mandatory checks are PASS/WAIVED/NOT_APPLICABLE, including required external registry confirmation, opening settlement, fresh compliance and mandate/product setup. CLOSE is emitted only after package 16 closure/maturity orchestration completes; REOPEN is emitted only after DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT_REOPENING is approved and executed. Checks scoped only to DEBIT_CAPABILITY/SERVICE_ONLY may instead create restrictions while the account lifecycle becomes ACTIVE.
